geography: PeMS District 8, San Bernardino, California, USA (highway sensors). NOT Hanoi.

source.provenance: File phan phoi boi ma nguon ASTGCN (Guo et al., AAAI 2019); cung kich thuoc byte voi ban trong cac kho STFGNN, STD-MAE, STSGCN_Pytorch. Khong tai truc tiep tu PeMS.
source.documented_by_source: 170 detectors, July to August 2016, 3 features: flow, occupy, speed (README ASTGCN)

period.timestamps_note: File NPZ KHONG chua timestamp. Moc thoi gian duoc SUY RA tu tai lieu nguon (1/7/2016 -> 31/8/2016, 62 ngay x 288 buoc). Kiem tra: ngay luu luong thap nhat la 4/7/2016 (le Quoc khanh My) va cac ngay Chu nhat; mau tuan khop lich. Gio la gio dia phuong Bac My (khong luu mui gio trong file).

sensors.id_note: sensor_id = chi so cot 0..169 trong NPZ (giu nguyen thu tu goc). Ma tram PeMS that khong co trong bo du lieu nay; khong gan ten duong, toa do hay camera nao.

distance_file.note: Danh sach canh from,to,cost theo chi so sensor 0..169. Don vi cua cost KHONG duoc nguon mo ta. Khong dung trong mo hinh.

channels_in_npz.evidence: kenh 0 la so nguyen 0..1147 (flow); kenh 1 trong 0..0.90 (occupancy); kenh 2 trong 3.0..82.3, trung vi 64.9 (speed).

units.flow: so xe moi 5 phut moi tram (tong cac lan) - theo quy uoc PeMS; file khong ghi don vi
units.speed_in_file: mph (SUY RA: quy uoc PeMS va trung vi 64.9 ~ gioi han toc do 65 mph; file khong ghi don vi)

aggregation_15min.rule: gop 3 buoc 5 phut lien tiep, timestamp = moc bat dau khoang
aggregation_15min.speed: trung binh so hoc (mph) roi doi sang km/h; khong gia quyen theo flow
aggregation_15min.zero_flow_steps: so buoc 5 phut co flow = 0 trong khoang (0..3), cot chat luong

labels.method: dich chuoi toc do cua tung sensor (da sap xep) di dung 1 gio; loai dong cuoi khong co tuong lai; khong backfill/forward-fill
labels.note: Nguong duoc dat cho do thi (km/h). Tren cao toc PEMS08 toc do thuong 60-70 mph (~100-110 km/h) nen hai lop un rat hiem - xem class_distribution.

derived_columns.zero_flow_steps: dem o flow = 0 (co the la khong co xe hoac khong do duoc; khong phan biet duoc)
derived_columns.current_level: muc un tac tu speed_kmh tai t
derived_columns.target_timestamp,target_speed_kmh,target: gia tri cua cung sensor tai t + 1 gio

excluded.weather: PEMS08 khong kem du lieu thoi tiet California; khong ghep thoi tiet Ha Noi.
excluded.incident_and_vehicle_class: Khong co trong PEMS08, khong dung.
excluded.hanoi_data: data/raw/* (Ha Noi, giao thong mo phong) la bo rieng, khong tham gia mo hinh nay.
